responsiveAcceptance.phoneLayout: One independent Power BI portrait layout; the grid scales across phone sizes and wide detail tables remain available in the landscape desktop layout.

layoutEquivalents.390: The same Power BI portrait grid scaled by the mobile runtime
layoutEquivalents.768: The fixed 1280x720 desktop canvas using Fit to page
layoutEquivalents.1440: The fixed 1280x720 desktop canvas using Fit to page

interactionContract.crossFilter: Charts cross-filter within the active page; selection must remain visible by label or border, not color alone.
interactionContract.emptyState: No rows in selected scope. Clear filters or contact your access administrator.
interactionContract.refreshFailure: Refresh failed. Preserve the last successful data-through date and do not display a false green state.
interactionContract.rlsNoEntitlement: Return zero protected Sales and Inventory rows and never reveal out-of-scope protected totals or entitlement lists; explicitly labelled global Product, Date, DQ, and refresh metadata remain visible.
